doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Kuldeep Shetty is the Consultant Neurologist, Parkinson s disease and other Movement Disorders Specialist, Department of Neurosciences at Narayana Health City, Bangalore.He completed both MBBS and MD (Internal Medicine) at MMCRI (Mysore Medical College and Research Institute, Mysore) and he completed his DM (Neurology) in 2016 at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Science and Technology (SCTIMST, an Institute of National Importance under the Govt. of India, Trivandrum, Kerala). He further pursued a post doctoral fellowship in Movement Disorders at SCTIMST which is one of the earliest comprehensive care centre for Movement Disorders in India and has been one of the pioneers of Deep Brain Stimulation in India. He has been serving as consultant neurologist at NH since Jan 2018.He has expertise in comprehensive care for Parkinson s disease and other movement disorders including Deep Brain Stimulation, Botulinum (botox) therapy for various disorders.
